_comment: The six, SPEC.md §5. A trooper's role picks his base numbers out of data/rules.json; his `traits` are ids from data/traits.json that modify those numbers through the hook system. Nothing in code reads a trooper by name (CLAUDE.md rule 6). A seventh trooper is one more entry here plus one more start hex in data/map.json (until the drop replaces start hexes at M6).
_leader: `leader` marks the ranking man. It picks his counter frame and makes him the source of the command radius in data/rules.json. It is a flag, not a name, so promoting someone else is a one-line edit here.
_shortName: What fits on the counter's name strip. It is not required to be the surname: Holloway goes by his nickname.
_dialogue: Three lines each, keyed onLand, onPlaceCharge, onWounded (SPEC.md §5). Every key is required, even for a man who will never place a charge. onWoundedCarrying is optional: said instead of onWounded when he is hit still carrying a charge, which then drops on his hex, so a line about the charge is only said when there is one to fetch. Give it to the men who start with charges; onWounded must then not mention one. These are PLACEHOLDER lines, written to be replaced.

dialogue.onLand: Right. Nobody wanders off till I've found the rest of you.
dialogue.onPlaceCharge: Set. Walk away from it — then run.
dialogue.onWounded: Only a scratch. Keep the lads moving.
dialogue.onWoundedCarrying: Charge is by my boots. Somebody fetch it — I'll catch you up.

dialogue.onLand: Down soft as you like. Whose cabbages are these?
dialogue.onPlaceCharge: Done. You'd not have got the wrapper off.
dialogue.onWoundedCarrying: Oh, that's torn it. Charge is on the deck — mind how you lift it.

dialogue.onLand: I can see the church from here. We're about right.
dialogue.onPlaceCharge: Not my trade, this. Hope it goes bang.
dialogue.onWounded: Should've kept my head down. Go on, I'll catch up.

dialogue.onLand: Missed every tree in France. Told you I would.
dialogue.onWounded: Leave it. Get to the bridge.

dialogue.onLand: Bren's in one piece. That's all that matters.
dialogue.onPlaceCharge: Don't ask me to do that again.
dialogue.onWounded: Bit of bother. Still got one good arm.

dialogue.onLand: Carried the spare all the way down, Sarge.
dialogue.onPlaceCharge: Heavy old thing. Glad to be shot of it.
dialogue.onWounded: Takes more than that to put an ox down.
dialogue.onWoundedCarrying: Somebody take the charge off me.
